LADA APS immobilizer bypass
Read the instruction below carefully and do all the steps
Close all vehicle doors. Switch the ignition on with the learning (red) key and wait at least 6 seconds.
Switch the ignition off and remove the learning (red) key from the ignition lock.
The lamp flashes fast while the learning procedure goes right.
While the indicator flashes (up to 6 seconds), insert the working (black) key and switch the ignition on.
The immobilizer beeps three times when the ignition is switched on.
Wait 6 seconds with the ignition on, then switch it off.
After 6 seconds the immobilizer beeps twice.
While the indicator flashes (up to 6 seconds), remove the key, insert the learning (red) key again and switch the ignition on.
Three beeps right when the ignition is switched on and two more after 6 seconds.
Switch the ignition off.
Don’t remove the learning (red) key from the ignition lock.
After 6 seconds the buzzer beeps once and the indicator flashes twice as fast.
No beep and the fast flashing stopped: switch the ignition off and start the procedure again.
Within 6 seconds after the beep (while the indicator flashes fast) switch the ignition on with the same learning (red) key. Switch it off after 2–3 seconds.
Within 5 seconds after switching off the buzzer beeps three times and the indicator stops flashing fast.
Switch the ignition off and remove the learning (red) key for at least 10 seconds.
Toyota/Daihatsu TX RX immobilizer bypass
Read the instruction below carefully and do all the steps.
Open the driver’s door and get into the vehicle.
Connect pin 13 of the OBDII connector to ground.
Switch the ignition on and off
4 times
After switching the ignition off, close and open the driver’s door
3 times
Close the door at the end.
Wait for the light and sound signal of successful learning.
